protocol.scale: V5 scores already divided by head.scale=20; T=1/20. Optical cosine uses the native component scale; no score calibration fitting

protocol.outputs: fixed original bridges isolate q/s decisions; conditional chosen proxy also used for S2O bridge and O2O first result in joint output
protocol.full_retrieval: original native top50 reranking pool, frozen V5 bank; only 44 original O2O queries lack source in the optical proxy gallery; transpose same costs for S2O; conditional mode proxy from best SAR for O2O

limitations: 40 repeated scenarios reuse only 44 multi-optical identities, not 40 independent tests
complete common distinct query identity assumption unproven for contest
proxy capacity unconstrained because gallery identity multiplicity is unknown
new score scale and T are fixed heuristics, not calibrated likelihoods
full independent retrieval is a sensitivity control, not the deployed query-coupled pipeline

protocol.purpose: Rule out missing image-capacity constraints after relaxed triad failure
protocol.reuse: Exactly the same 40 shared scenes and eight replacement stress scenes
protocol.assumption: Optical queries distinct identities, as in original shared scenario; not confirmed for actual competition
protocol.candidates: K=5 optical neighbors after excluding observed source images already owned by other queries; anchors keep own image
protocol.energy: Same equal direct/proxy weights and native cosine penalty; soft T=.05; no tuning
protocol.capacity: One non-null proxy image per distinct query; unknown multiple images of an identity are not merged
protocol.null: No second observation, energy=original unary; retain original optical bridge/ranking in final retrieval
protocol.solver: Alternating exact q/SAR and q/proxy injections; at most12 rounds; two starts (original V5 and filtered fixed proxy); choose larger model energy, never validation score
protocol.global_optimality: Not claimed; three-way joint optimization is nonconvex/discrete
protocol.gate: Need shared gain>=.03 over V5 and >=.01 over both old and filtered fixed proxies, without O2O score drop >.005, before further expansion
